Sample collection and report generation:

Booking cancellation policy.

(15) You have the option to modify/reschedule or cancel your booking at any time before the samples get collected. Sent us your request from your registered mobile number to +91 8078 900 901 or e-mail us to labzappcare@gmail.com. Our booking manager will support you to re-schedule your booking to a future date. Don’t forget to mention your booking id number in your request.

(16) Customers are free to cancel the test prior to home visit, however any customer chooses to cancel the test after the arrival of a technician or phlebotomist at the site, the booking service charge shall be collected as visit charges. You are not allowed to cancel the booking or claim refund after the samples are collected.
